source.section: Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7; record wi_standard_deduction cite: Form 1 Instructions PDF pages 35-37

worked: Married filing jointly, you 70 (still working, wages 30,000; no retirement income), spouse 62 (wages 40,000). Line 10b counts only the spouse 65 or older: one 250. No retirement income, so line 16 has nothing to subtract. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 30,000.00 + wages (spouse) 40,000.00 = 70,000.00. Federal taxable income = 70,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 + 1 x 1,600.00 = 36,900.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 70,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 70,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 70,000.00. Schedule SB: no subtraction applies; line 50 0.00. Schedule SB line 17: federal AGI 70,000.00 is not less than 30,000.00, so no 5,000 subtraction. Form 1 line 6 0.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 70,000.00 - 0.00 = 70,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 70,000 to less than 70,500, column Married filing jointly: 16,795.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 70,000 / 70,500 / 7,476 / 16,795 / 684 / 7,476). Line 9 = 70,000.00 - 16,795.00 = 53,205.00. Line 10a 2 x 700 = 1,400.00; line 10b 1 x 250 = 250.00; line 10c 1,650.00. Line 11 taxable income = 53,205.00 - 1,650.00 = 51,555.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule B (joint) as numbers: 3.5% x 19,580.00 = 685.30 + 4.4% x 31,975.00 = 1,406.90; total 2,092.20, rounded once to 2,092.20. The Tax Table row 51,500 to 51,600 (PDF page 41) gives 2,092; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 2,092.20.
